summary: Implemented the SHACL path parser. Added rdflib/extras/shacl.py with parse_shacl_path and SHACLPathError, and test/test_extras/test_shacl_extras.py. The new tests and test/test_path.py pass (41 tests). Nothing was committed. mypy, black, ruff, and isort are not installed in the shared venv, so type-checking and formatting were not run; only line lengths were checked by hand. One deliberate deviation from the spec: a Node isinstance guard runs before the blank-node lookups, because graph.value(None, ...) would treat None as a wildcard.
